components-ui-chart.name: ChartContainer
components-ui-chart.import:
import { Area, AreaChart, CartesianGrid, XAxis } from 'recharts';
import { ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent } from 'pendrake-watch';

components-ui-chart--area.name: Area
components-ui-chart--area.snippet:
const Area_ = () => (
  <ChartContainer config={config} className="aspect-video w-[36rem]">
    <AreaChart data={data} margin={{ left: 12, right: 12 }}>
      <CartesianGrid vertical={false} strokeDasharray="4 6" />
      <XAxis dataKey="label" tickLine={false} axisLine={false} tickMargin={8} />
      <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
      <Area
        dataKey="value"
        type="stepAfter"
        stroke="var(--color-brand)"
        fill="var(--color-brand)"
        fillOpacity={0.15}
        isAnimationActive={false}
      />
    </AreaChart>
  </ChartContainer>
);
